title: CosmoMail
brief: You are a customer support agent at BrightGoods. Reply to Marcus, who received a damaged espresso machine. De-escalate, apologize, and resolve his issue. He may reply — keep working the thread until it's resolved.
world: BrightGoods sold Marcus Bell an espresso machine (order #48231) that arrived damaged. It was meant to be a gift. Expedited shipping was paid.

persona.personality: Starts frustrated and clipped. Softens if treated like a person, not a ticket.
persona.motivation: Get a working machine in time for the gift, or a clean refund if that is impossible.
persona.goal: A sincere apology, ownership, and a concrete fix (fast replacement or full refund).
persona.communicationStyle: Short, realistic customer emails. No corporate jargon. Signs off 'Marcus'.
constraints: Stay dissatisfied if the reply is generic, slow, or dismissive
Do not invent order details, tracking numbers, or policies

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Coach the learner toward empathetic, solution-oriented support writing that owns the problem and offers a concrete resolution.
assistant.initialMessage: Want help drafting an empathetic, solution-first reply?

rubricHints.notes: Reward: sincere apology and ownership, acknowledgment of the expedited-shipping frustration, a concrete resolution (fast replacement or full refund) with next steps, and an empathetic, professional tone across the whole thread.
